preheader: Two cleared every filter, one earns a call, one fractional seat is open.
headline: Two cleared.
Target was five.
lede: The sweep covered every codified source and verified each shortlisted posting on the employer's own board. Two clearing the bar is a thin week rather than a bad one.

shortlist.role: Senior or Staff Software Engineer, Cloud Platform Reliability and Developer Experience
shortlist.arrangement: Remote across the United States with two planning weeks a year held in person at the head office
shortlist.why: Clears every hard filter. Comp sits above the floor and the posting is nine days old.
shortlist.about: They run metering and settlement for community solar co-ops. Verified on their own board, which lists the role as open and remote in every US state.

shortlist.why: Clears on scope and comp. The quarterly travel is the one thing to weigh.
shortlist.about: Flood modelling for county governments. The posting had no public url, so it was verified on the careers page listing alone.

flagged.why: A growth engineering title under the comp floor, which is the escape hatch that still earns a call.

fractional.why: A small ops team with no engineering leadership and a route planning rebuild ahead of them.
fractional.detail: Added on Thursday and confirmed open by a note on the listing. The engagement is scoped at two quarters.

fractional.why: Rate is not posted, which usually means it is negotiable and usually means it is low.
fractional.detail: Listed twice in three weeks, which reads as a seat nobody has taken.

prospects: The Lane B read stayed quiet: two issues, neither naming a company that hires this shape.
tradeoff: The waste hauler seat sits at the practice band, so taking it is a month the practice does not get.

rejected.reason: Hybrid three days on its own posting
Manager role, not an IC seat
Comp band tops out under the floor

rejected.company: Thornfield Ridge Energy Cooperative, Principal Platform Reliability Engineer
rejected.reason: Onsite four days in a city the posting never names, relocation expected inside ninety days, and the listed band tops out well under the floor even at the principal level.

rejected_note: Another 14 were resurfaced dedupes and 6 were deny list hits, neither individually verified.

sources.note: The cert failure from the last two sweeps did not repeat.
The platform engineering query returned its full page, so anything past twenty was not seen.
